analysis:
Docs-only change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the date to 2026-10-16 and adds a 'Local GLM qualification' section (head lines 18-60). The patch excerpt is truncated and the range map lists a head change at 1695, but only head lines 1-842 were supplied, so the tail is unexamined.

Security-relevant claims in the new section:
- GLM is gated by DARKBLOOM_EXPERIMENTAL_GLM5_NEXT, which must be an absolute qualification JSON path pinning the catalog record, manifest and aggregate (lines 20-25). Unset, empty, '1' or mismatched values refuse GLM.
- The variable is not forwarded into launchd and never advertises the identity to the coordinator (lines 33, 52-54).
- Coordinator-connected serving is limited to catalog build glm-5.3-flash on M5 Max/Ultra with at least 256 GB (lines 54-60).
- The encrypted SSD prefix store is default-on for the GLM MTP model, and DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 opts out (lines 40-41). This falls under T-041 (SEC-035 accepted risk).
- Image rows run target-only with no prefix reuse (lines 49-51).
- Inline data:video/mp4 and data:video/quicktime input is sampled at 2 FPS (line 51). This touches T-050 (inline video plaintext in provider temp files) and TB-007.

No code changed, so no control regression is demonstrable. Unverified contracts, since the implementation is not in the supplied evidence:
- Whether the GLM embedded-MTP engine is covered by T-041's 'eligible CBv2 model' per-donation gating, HMAC lookup tags and 30-minute TTL. T-041's affected_files list does not name GLM files.
- Whether the GLM video path avoids plaintext temp files, per the T-050 mitigation.

The next pass should check the GLM source, if it appears, against T-041 and T-050. It should also read the unseen tail near line 1695 of the cli-reference for security-relevant claims.
